source.legacy_3d: present in serialized container but discarded after restricted loading; never used as model input or quality filter
source.labels: official coarse labels copied only; no classifier or performance-based preprocessing selection

model.root: overwrite predicted H36M joint0 with exact zero after flip mean, as official root-relative inference

lifting.short_padding: repeat last pose, keep only real-frame output
lifting.overlap: uniform arithmetic mean, float64 accumulation then float32
lifting.coco_xy_to_h36m: SAFER official coco_to_h36m direct limbs and midpoint pelvis/shoulders/spine/eyes
lifting.confidence: replace only nonfinite scores with zero; preserve COCO score order to match official SAFER batch input, even though XY is reordered; do not silently fix this legacy confidence-index limitation
lifting.screen: float32 H36M XY / image width * 2 - [1,height/width]; confidence unchanged
lifting.invalid_windows: no confidence threshold, no zero-window exclusion; preserve all finite 2D frames, unlike legacy batch confidence gating

ntu_proxy.scale: sequence median positive length joint20-joint0; epsilon1e-8; all-degenerate scale1 and flag, do not remove
ntu_proxy.rotation: sequence first shoulder with XZ norm>1e-8, yaw atan2(z,x), active Ry(+yaw) applied to column vectors so XZ shoulder maps to +X; no Y flip or gravity alignment
ntu_proxy.root_trajectory: scaled, rotated SpineMid before centering; body-relative diagnostic, NOT physical world translation

materialization.split_membership: official sub_train/sub_test, same validation subjects and annotation order as reconstructed V1; OOD official sub_test
materialization.lying_origin: only coarse12 bouts: immediately preceding coarse10=>0 fall-origin, coarse11=>1 intentional-origin, otherwise -1 unknown; -1 outside bouts; no smoothing or gap filling
materialization.sample_name: normalized source name + __f + zero-padded seven-digit start

execution.resume: identical code/config; completed sequence for lifting, flushed completed sequence for materialization

newly_specified_not_recovered: precise official COCO2D conversion and confidence-order policy
lying-origin label definition and root trajectory meaning
float64 overlap arithmetic and deterministic runtime
single physical GPU0 instead of historical GPU0/1
